name: connectorforge-review
description: Review MCP tool definitions for permission and approval risks, and build reproducible offline agent–tool evaluation plans. Skills-only; no network access or automatic scanning.

interface.longDescription: Review MCP tool definitions and plugin descriptions for correctness, risky writes, authorization and approval boundaries, organization isolation, error handling, and prompt-injection concerns. Generate offline tool-selection, failure, and safety evaluation cases with measurable pass/fail criteria. Produces an evidence-based review report and a development checklist. Skills-only in v0.1: it does not connect to or scan a live MCP server, run code, validate authentication, or certify security.
defaultPrompt: Review this MCP tool manifest for permissions, approvals, and potential misuse.
Create an offline tool-selection and safety evaluation suite from these tools.
Help prepare my skills-only plugin for the public plugin directory.

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only developer review workflow: MCP tool audits, offline agent–tool evaluation design, and plugin-submission preparation.
